physical_only_risks: Actual stock Nintendo Switch FRLG interoperability and gameplay timing.
Actual selected Wi-Fi radio/driver/firmware/kernel association, CCMP, RX stability and teardown under physical failure.
Real Internet latency/loss and console-dependent behavior beyond modeled boundaries; relay is trusted TLS hop termination.
Correct pre-existing managed WSL provisioning, user-supplied keys and exact USB ownership must be confirmed on each physical PC.
notes: Manifest is not a PASS or physical claim. Final artifact requires both exact-SHA platform CI jobs including all required steps. Full local and CI evidence are reported separately; previous partial observations remain labeled historical.
additional_findings: Early VIF and LDN socket ownership; nonblocking Trio cancellation enqueue and sticky stop failure.
Actual local LDN lifecycle and preactive transport loss guard; bounded two-source reconnect epoch resync.
Actual child Pia FINALIZE never observed valid Reliable; automatic mirror RTT/Session retry/local pre-admission maintenance were missing.
Default local peer identity, raw datagram length/fragment/source validation and key-file shape classification.
PowerShell typed catch masked actual errors; deny check ran before source allowlisting; one-file array shape failed.
Windows common relay environment was not forwarded to WSL; source SHA/content identity now travels to diagnostics.
Owned parent pipe plus Linux process-group guardian; actual Windows Ctrl+C and Linux EOF into real CLI/StageSession.
CI104/112 Windows reader PermissionError was not covered by atomic writer retry.
Trio body-failure/cancellation propagation is distinguished from new teardown failures only with independent named leaf release proof.
Opt-in gate/cleanup/counter diagnostics exclude keys, MACs, advertisement and RFU payloads.
Legacy resource soak now owns its measured process instead of measuring all pytest workers; native resource bounds unchanged, Python identities and zero owned-thread residue additionally asserted.
revision_binding: This tracked acceptance manifest is resolved to literal GITHUB_SHA by the software-preflight CI job after both mandatory platform jobs succeed. The downloadable ABC_SOFTWARE_PREFLIGHT_CLOSURE.final.json is the final attestation; a file cannot contain its own Git commit hash.
